title: Gender Trouble in Language Models: An Empirical Audit Guided by Gender Performativity Theory

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating conditional probabilities and Log Probability Ratios (LPR) for sentence completions to measure how language models align gender identity terms (e.g., man, woman, nonbinary) with biological sex characteristics (e.g., testosterone, estrogen), evaluating the models for binary and essentialist representations.

Using matched guise probing to compare the conditional probabilities of illness-related word predictions given different gender contexts, specifically evaluating the disproportionate association of transgender and gender-diverse identities with mental illnesses versus physical illnesses (pathologization).
